title: Design: A customer that bills itself shows no Bill Invoices To line
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have a customer with no saved Bill Invoices To (it bills itself) and nobody billing it by default.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p1-11-before-customer-page.png, bt-p5-10-after-orchard-city-invoices.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The card ends with IBS, then the divider and the Contacts and Assets counters, as in production.
  • No "Bill Invoices To" line, no "Change" and no "Pays for" counter show.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12303 (Story 1, Saved default Bill To on the customer page)

  • S1-N1: “A customer that bills itself shows no "Bill Invoices To" line and no way to set one on the card; the default is set in New Customer or Edit Customer (Story 2).”
  • S1-N4: “The "Pays for" counter is hidden when the count is 0.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: page "1 Set a customer's default Bill To / 5 Getting paid", pictures "Customer page" (Production (v26.45.2.1)), "Orchard City, Invoices" (This build).
